correctness.rationale: For each 2j-block of 1s starting at h, the contribution 2^h(2^{2j}-1) is divisible by 3. For the converse, the 8 possible states (odd/even open-run parities of each summand plus binary carry) give a nondeterministic LSB-first addition machine; a 0 after an odd run is forbidden. Determinization with the mod-3 residue and parity of the binary digit index has exactly 10 reachable configurations, closed under both input bits, and the NFA acceptor (0,0,0) occurs exactly when residue=0. The independent construction recreated all 10 states and 20 transitions, proving an all-input-length regular-language identity, not extrapolating a numerical range. Zero and end-of-word finishing parities are handled by the unique accepting state; 9 not in E, but 3 and 6 are, giving sharp order.
